commands.title: boxcode: Change Provider / Model / API Key

boxcode.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `boxcode` binary, if it isn't on the PATH this app was launched with (a GUI-launched app's inherited PATH doesn't always match a login shell's -- e.g. a binary installed to `~/.cargo/bin` on macOS). Leave empty to resolve `boxcode` off PATH normally.

boxcode.provider.markdownDescription: Registry id of the LLM provider picked during setup (e.g. `deepseek`), or empty for a manually-entered custom endpoint. Set automatically by the setup flow and by `boxcode: Change Provider / Model / API Key` -- not normally edited by hand.

boxcode.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL for boxcode's OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com`). Leave empty to be prompted on first use, or if `~/.boxcode/config.toml` already has one set up from using the `boxcode` CLI directly.

boxcode.model.markdownDescription: Model name to request from the configured endpoint. Set automatically by the setup flow; run `boxcode: Change Provider / Model / API Key` to change it.
